;Sacred Scripture: Kanro no Hōu (甘露の法雨)

==The Lamplighter of the Seven Lighthouses==
:The revelation from "The Lamplighter of the Seven Lighthouses"

:Be reconciled with all things in heaven and earth.
:When reconciliation with all things in heaven and earth is achieved,
:all things in heaven and earth become your allies.
:When all things in heaven and earth become your allies,
:nothing in all creation can harm you.
:If you are wounded by something,
:or afflicted by germs or evil spirits,
:it is proof that you have not reconciled with all things in heaven and earth — reflect and make peace.
:When I once said before the altar of God, "First be reconciled with your brother before you offer your gift," this is what I meant.

:The greatest among your brothers are your father and mother.
:One who is grateful to God but cannot be grateful to parents does not accord with the heart of God.
:To be reconciled with all things in heaven and earth means to be grateful to all things in heaven and earth.
:True reconciliation cannot be achieved through mutual forbearance
:or endurance.
:To merely endure and persevere is not true reconciliation in the depths of the heart.
:True reconciliation is achieved when we are mutually grateful.
:One who is grateful to God but not grateful to all things in heaven and earth has not achieved reconciliation with all things in heaven and earth.
:If reconciliation with all things in heaven and earth is not achieved,
:even though God would wish to help,
:the waves of contention cannot receive God's waves of salvation.
:Be grateful for the grace of the Emperor.
:Be grateful to your father and mother.
:Be grateful to your husband or wife.
:Be grateful to your children.
:Be grateful to your servants.
:Be grateful to all people.
:Be grateful to all things in heaven and earth.
:Within that gratitude, you will see my form
:and receive my salvation.
:Since I am the totality of all, I exist only within those who have reconciled with all.
:I am not found where people say "See me here"
:or "See me there."
:Therefore, I do not descend upon mediums.
:Do not think that by summoning God to a medium, God will come.
:If you wish to summon me, be reconciled with all things in heaven and earth and summon me.
:Since I am love, when you are reconciled with all things in heaven and earth, I will manifest there.
:(Divine revelation, night of September 27, Shōwa 6 [1931])

:The time has come.
:Now all the sick can rise.
:No longer —
:the time has come when illness no longer exists for you.
:Two thousand years ago,
:with the single phrase "According to your faith, so be it unto you,"
:Christ healed the sick who were in distant places —
:the time has come when that truth is revealed to all humanity.
:See the fact that just by reading ''Seicho-No-Ie'' and learning the truth, illness is healed from afar.
:''Seicho-No-Ie'' now stands before humanity as the "completed (seven-fold) lighthouse" prophesied in the Book of Revelation.
:Those who receive the light of truth from this lighthouse
:extinguish the three darknesses of "sin," "illness," and "death"
:that have afflicted humanity since the expulsion from Eden in Genesis.
:As light approaches, all darkness vanishes.
:As "truth" approaches,
:all "delusion" vanishes.
:When "delusion" vanishes,
:the products of delusion — "sin," "illness," and "death" — vanish.
:Receive my light without doubt.
:I am the one who lights the lamps of the "completed (seven-fold) lighthouse."
:(Divine revelation, January 15, Shōwa 6 [1931])

==Kami-Yobi-Uta==
;God-Calling Song

===Divine Invocation Hymn===
;Shinkinka
:O ancestral deity who gives life to all living things, grant us grace from the primal spirit.
:That I live is not by my own power — it is the life of the ancestral deity that lives through heaven and earth.
:That I act is not through my own doing — it is the authority of the ancestral deity that lives through heaven and earth.
:O great deity of Seicho-No-Ie, who has manifested to transmit the way of the ancestral deity of heaven and earth, protect us.

===God===
;God

:One day an angel came to Seicho-No-Ie and sang:
:The God of creation
:transcends the five senses,
:transcends the sixth sense too,
:Holy,
:Supreme,
:Infinite,
:mind that pervades the universe,
:life that pervades the universe,
:law that pervades the universe,
:truth,
:light,
:wisdom,
:absolute love.
:These are the Great Life —
:the true nature of the absolute God,
:and when God manifests,
:it becomes goodness,
:it becomes righteousness,
:it becomes compassion,
:harmony is naturally present,
:all living beings find their place and none contend,
:none devour one another,
:none are ill,
:none suffer,
:none are in want.
:God is the ruler of all,
:and since God abides in all and is absolute,
:there is nothing outside of God.
:God encompasses all reality.
:There is nothing that exists
:that was not made by God.
:When God created all things,
:God used no clay,
:no wood,
:no hammer,
:no chisel,
:no tool or material of any kind,
:but created solely with "mind."
:"Mind" is the creator of all,
:"mind" is the substance filling the universe,
:"mind" is the omnipotent God, omnipresent.
:When this omnipotent God,
:this perfect God's
:"mind" moves and becomes the Word,
:all phenomena unfold and all things are made.
:All things are the mind of God,
:all things are the Word of God,
:all is spirit,
:all is mind —
:nothing is made of matter.
:Matter is merely the shadow of mind;
:to see a shadow and take it for reality is delusion.
:Take care not to be captured by delusion.
:Your "reality" is eternal and does not perish.
:Delusion is momentary and instantly shattered.
:"Reality" is free, without suffering;
:delusion is the aspect of bondage, full of suffering.
:"Reality" is truth;
:"delusion" is false appearance.
:Reality transcends the five senses
:and even transcends the sixth sense,
:and cannot be reflected in people's perception.

===Spirit===
;Spirit

:The senses are nothing but seeing the shadow of belief.
:Even if you possess spiritual sight and see spiritual forms,
:you have not seen reality.
:What can be seen by the senses
:is all the shadow of mind and not ultimate reality.
:Among spiritual forms there are gradations:
:there are sick spirits,
:suffering spirits,
:spirits suffering from stomach ailments though they have no stomach,
:spirits suffering from heart disease though they have no heart —
:all of this is delusion.
:When such a spirit possesses a person,
:the possessed person may manifest stomach disease
:or heart disease.
:Yet the various suffering spirits
:reflected in spiritual perception
:are not ultimate reality;
:they are the shadow of delusion that flows
:from mistaken belief.
:A mind wandering and flowing in delusion
:will take form from its beliefs and manifest a provisional appearance.
:But however an appearance manifests,
:a provisional appearance is forever a provisional appearance and cannot become reality.
:Do not fear what is not reality;
:do not treat what is not reality as if it were reality.
:Meet what is not reality with reality.
:Meet what is not true with truth.
:Meet the provisional appearance with the true image.
:Meet darkness with light.
:There is nothing that destroys non-reality except reality itself.
:There is nothing that shatters the provisional appearance except the true image.
:There is nothing that destroys illusion except truth.
:There is nothing that proves the nothingness of darkness except light.
:Teach them the true image of life.
:Teach them that the true image of life is God itself and is perfect.
:Since God is all,
:since God has not made sin,
:since there is no creator other than God,
:in this world there is no sin that has been committed
:and no sin that must be punished — teach them this.
:All spirits of the three realms,
:all lives of the three realms —
:contemplate this truth,
:awaken to this truth,
:and shatter the inverted delusions
:that become the source of all suffering,
:and all the gods of heaven will rain down a chorus of truth,
:all lives of the present world will look up to the light,
:all obstructions of delusion will vanish, and this world as it is will manifest as a world of radiant light.

===Matter===
;Matter

:Do not regard the matter
:perceived by your senses as reality.
:Matter is not the substance of things,
:it is not life,
:it is not truth;
:matter in itself has no intellect
:and no sensation.
:Matter is in the end "nothingness" and has no inherent qualities of its own.
:What gives it qualities is nothing other than "mind."
:When the mind thinks of health, health is produced;
:when the mind thinks of illness, illness is produced.
:This is just as
:on a cinema screen
:a wrestler is projected and a wrestler appears,
:a sick person is projected and a sick person appears,
:yet the film itself
:is colorless and transparent — fundamentally there is neither wrestler
:nor sick person —
:but only various patterns produced by the photographic emulsion
:covering the colorless, transparent substance,
:which manifest now as the form of a wrestler,
:now as the form of a sick person.
:Yet the healthy wrestler
:and the frail sick person
:are both shadows produced by the action of the photographic emulsion
:and are not reality.
:If you place in a film projector
:a film with no such patterns produced by photographic emulsion —
:a colorless, transparent film —
:and project it onto the screen,
:there would be no wrestler who will age and die,
:no frail sick person of course,
:and on the screen would be only radiant light itself,
:life itself,
:blazing and shining brilliantly.
:Know now:
:your "life" is something beyond even the life of a healthy wrestler.
:However healthy a wrestler may be,
:as long as he views the physical body as reality
:and regards the body as himself,
:he is one who will perish and does not have true "health."
:True "health" is not matter, is not the physical body;
:true "life" is not matter, is not the physical body.
:In the depths of matter,
:in the depths of the body,
:there is an utterly wondrous and perfect existence.
:This is the perfect "you as you truly are" just as God created you —
:the eternally healthy, immortal "life."
:Transcend matter now,
:and become aware of the true image of your own "life."

===Reality===
;Reality

:The angel continued teaching:
:Reality is eternal,
:reality does not fall ill,
:reality does not age,
:reality does not die.
:Knowing this truth is called knowing the Way.
:Because reality fills the universe without lack, it is called the Way.
:The Way is together with God;
:God is the Way, is reality.
:One who knows reality and dwells in reality
:transcends extinction
:and is forever perfectly complete.
:Life knows life and does not know death.
:Life is another name for reality;
:reality has no beginning, no end,
:no perishing, no dying — therefore
:life likewise has no beginning, no end,
:no perishing, no annihilation.
:Life is not within the measure of time,
:not within the measure of decay;
:rather, time is in the palm of life's hand —
:grasp it and it becomes a single point,
:open it and it becomes infinite.
:One who thinks "I am young" instantly becomes young again;
:one who thinks "I am old" instantly ages — how natural this is.
:Space likewise does not limit life;
:space is rather only a "form of perception" created by life.
:Life is the master; space is the servant.
:The patterns of ideas radiated by life
:projected upon space —
:these are called matter.
:Matter is fundamentally nothingness
:and has no inherent nature or power.
:That it appears to have qualities
:and seems to possess the power to control life
:is a "distortion" that arises when life passes through the "form of perception."
:Do not be captured by this "distortion";
:rightly observe the true image of life.
:One who knows the true image of life
:transcends karma and obtains the perfectly complete freedom of life's original, undistorted nature.

===Wisdom===
;Wisdom

:Wisdom is originally the light of God,
:the perfectly complete light that accompanies reality;
:it is immeasurable light, infinite light, without bound;
:and because it is without bound,
:it fills all things
:and illuminates all things.
:Since humanity is the child of light and is always within light,
:it knows no darkness,
:knows no stumbling,
:knows no obstruction —
:just as heavenly beings wander through the heavenly realm,
:just as fish in the sea swim through water,
:humanity wanders through a world of light, filled with light, filled with spiritual joy.
:Wisdom is the light of enlightenment
:and the truth that breaks through the darkness of ignorance.
:Only truth is reality;
:ignorance is simply truth not yet awakened,
:like a bad dream.
:Do not have bad dreams.
:When you awaken, this world instantly becomes a pure land of radiant light,
:and humanity will manifest the true image of luminous life.
:God is wisdom of immeasurable, infinite light,
:limitless goodness,
:limitless life,
:the substance of all things,
:and the creator of all things;
:therefore God is omnipresent everywhere.
:Because God is the omnipresent substance and creator,
:goodness alone is the only power,
:goodness alone is the only life,
:goodness alone is the only reality;
:therefore there can never be a power that is not goodness,
:there can never be a life that is not goodness,
:and there can never be a reality that is not goodness.
:A power that is not goodness — that is, a power that brings misfortune — is in the end nothing but a bad dream.
:A life that is not goodness — that is, illness — is in the end nothing but a bad dream.
:All disharmony and imperfection is in the end nothing but a bad dream.
:It is our bad dream that has given positive power to illness, misfortune, disharmony, and imperfection;
:just as we suffer in a dream being pressed down by a demon,
:when we awaken we see that in reality nothing presses down upon us —
:it is as though we ourselves press upon our own chests with our own minds.
:Truly, the power of evil,
:the power that suppresses our life,
:the power that causes us suffering,
:is not a power that truly, objectively exists.
:It is nothing more than our own mind
:tormenting itself through a dream it has itself drawn.
:In the Buddhist way, this is called avidya (ignorance);
:in the way of God, this is called sin.
:Because one does not awaken to the true image of perfectly complete life, it is called ignorance.
:Because one wraps the true image of perfectly complete life and does not let it manifest, it is called sin and defilement.

===Ignorance===
;Avidya

:As the angel sang thus in Seicho-No-Ie,
:a heavenly child appeared and asked a question, saying:
:"For the sake of people, for their awakening, please make clear the nature of ignorance."
:The angel answered:
:Ignorance is called ignorance because it imagines something that does not exist to exist.
:Not knowing the true nature of things is called delusion.
:Though pleasure and pain are fundamentally not within matter,
:one imagines that pleasure and pain exist within matter
:and either pursues it or flees from it —
:such inverted delusions are called delusion.
:Though life is fundamentally not within matter,
:imagining that life exists within matter is called delusion.
:Fundamentally, matter is within mind.
:Mind is the master of matter,
:and the qualities and forms of matter are entirely created by mind;
:yet mistakenly believing that mind is governed by matter,
:grieving and anguishing in accordance with material changes,
:and being unable to awaken to the perfectly complete true image of one's own life —
:this is called delusion.
:Because delusion is the opposite of truth, it is called ignorance.
:Because delusion is contrary to reality, it is non-reality.
:If delusion were truly real,
:then the grief and anguish born of delusion would likewise be real.
:But since delusion is hollow compared to reality,
:grief and anguish are also merely bad dreams to be awakened from
:and are not reality.

===Sin===
;Sin

:"Is sin real?" the heavenly child asked again.
:The angel's answering voice was heard, saying:
:All truly real things
:are only God and what comes forth from God.
:God is perfect,
:and everything God has created is also perfect.
:Then let me ask: do you consider sin to be perfect?
:At this point the heavenly child answered:
:"Teacher, sin is not perfect."
:The angel taught again:
:Because sin is imperfect, it is not reality;
:because illness is imperfect, it is not reality;
:because death is imperfect, it is not reality.
:Do not regard what God has not made as reality.
:Do not depict in a bad dream what does not exist and then fear it.
:Sin, illness, and death
:are not God's creation — therefore,
:although they wear the mask of reality,
:they are non-reality, illusion.
:I have come to strip away this mask
:and to make clear the non-reality of sin, illness, and death.
:Once, Shakyamuni Buddha also came for this purpose.
:Once, Jesus Christ also came for this purpose.
:If sin were reality,
:all the Buddhas of the ten directions could not extinguish it.
:The cross of Jesus Christ could not extinguish it either.
:But how fortunate you are:
:because sin is non-reality and the shadow of delusion,
:all the Buddhas of the ten directions
:have gathered living beings and extinguished sin.
:Jesus Christ also,
:with only the words "Your sins are forgiven," was able to
:extinguish sin.
:I too, through words,
:have had the ''Song of Seicho-No-Ie'' written,
:and through the power of words expose the nature of sin
:and cause sin to return to its original nothingness.
:Those who read my words,
:because they know the true image of reality,
:will have all sin extinguished.
:Those who read my words,
:because they know the true image of life,
:will have all illness extinguished
:and will live eternally, transcending death.

===Humanity===
;Humanity

:I am "Truth,"
:an angel sent from "Truth."
:I am "Light" shining from "Truth,"
:the "Light" that breaks through delusion.
:I am the "Way";
:those who carry out my words do not go against the Way.
:I am Life;
:those who draw from me do not fall ill and do not die.
:I am Salvation;
:those who rely on me are all gathered into
:the land of the true image.
:As the angel taught thus,
:the heavenly child asked again:
:"Teacher, please make clear the nature of humanity."
:The angel answered:
:Humanity is not matter,
:not the physical body,
:not brain cells,
:not nerve cells,
:not blood cells,
:not serum,
:not muscle cells.
:Nor is it any combination of all of these.
:You should well awaken to the true image of humanity:
:humanity is spirit,
:life,
:immortal.
:God is the source of light for humanity,
:and humanity is the light that comes forth from God.
:There is no light source without light,
:and there is no light without a light source.
:Just as light and light source are one,
:humanity and God are one.
:Because God is spirit,
:humanity is likewise spirit.
:Because God is love,
:humanity is likewise love.
:Because God is wisdom,
:humanity is likewise wisdom.
:Spirit is not the nature of matter,
:love is not the nature of matter,
:wisdom is not the nature of matter;
:therefore,
:humanity, which is spirit, love, and wisdom,
:has no connection whatsoever to matter.
:The true person,
:because they are spirit,
:because they are love,
:because they are wisdom,
:because they are life,
:cannot commit sin,
:cannot fall ill,
:cannot perish and die.
:Sin,
:illness,
:death —
:in the end, these are nothing but your bad dreams.
:Become aware of the true image of life.
:Become aware of the "true human being" that is your true image.
:The "true human being" is a divine person,
:the very form of God as God is.
:What perishes is not the "true human being."
:What commits sin is not the "true human being."
:What falls ill is not the "true human being."
:O people of the earth:
:I proclaim to you,
:become aware of your own true nature.
:You yourselves are the "true human being"
:and nothing other than that.
:Therefore, when humanity is seen through the eye of truth,
:they are beings who cannot commit sin,
:beings who cannot fall ill,
:beings who cannot perish.
:Who says "Sinner! Sinner!"?
:Because God has not created sinners,
:there is not a single sinner in this world.
:Sin is contrary to the true nature of God's children;
:illness is contrary to the true nature of life itself;
:death is contrary to the true nature of life itself.
:Sin, illness, and death
:are in the end nothing but delusions drawn in a dream of what does not exist.
:In the world of the true image,
:God and humanity are one;
:God is the source of light
:and humanity is the light that comes forth from God.
:The root delusion that makes humanity dream
:the bad dream that sin, illness, and death exist
:is, in ancient times,
:the theology that says humanity was made from dust;
:and in recent times,
:the modern science that says humanity was made from matter.
:These are the first dreams that lead humanity into the delusions of sin, illness, and death.
:When this first dream is shattered,
:the root cause of sin, illness, and death
:is shattered
:and returns to its original nothingness.
:The reason those who read ''Seicho-No-Ie'' and learn the truth are healed of illness
:is that this first dream is shattered.
:When there is no first dream,
:there are no subsequent dreams.
:When all dreams are gone, since humanity is fundamentally pure,
:one may wish to commit sin
:yet cannot commit sin;
:when all dreams are gone, since one's nature is fundamentally free from illness,
:one may wish to fall ill
:yet cannot fall ill;
:when all dreams are gone, since one is fundamentally eternal life, one cannot perish and die.
:Therefore, O people of the earth,
:seek with all your heart your own spiritual essence,
:and do not seek it in matter and the physical body,
:which are products of dreams and delusions.
:Christ said:
:"The kingdom of God is within you."
:Truly, truly, I say to you:
:"Within you" means your "human true nature,"
:the "true person."
:Because "within you," namely "true nature," is a divine person,
:the kingdom of God exists only "within you."
:Those who seek it outside are those who run after dreams
:and can never possess the kingdom of God.
:Those who seek the kingdom of God in matter
:are those who run after dreams
:and can never build the kingdom of God.
:Christ also said:
:"My kingdom is not of this world."
:The kingdom of this world is only a shadow.
:The land of eternal joy exists only within;
:only by becoming aware of the land of eternal joy within
:will the land of eternal joy manifest outside as its reflection.
:Only by becoming aware within of the life of infinite health
:will infinite health of the body manifest outside as its reflection.
:The five senses of humanity see only the "reflected world."
:If you wish to purify the "reflected world," purify the original plate of the mind
:and remove the stains of delusion.
:I have truly seen the emptiness of the material world,
:seen that the material world is nothing but a shadow.
:I have also seen that humanity is light radiated from God.
:I have seen the fact that the physical body is merely the shadow of the mind.
:Know: matter is nothing but a shifting, changing shadow,
:like the horses running in a revolving lantern.
:Therefore, do not see a shadow and take it for reality.
:The true nature of humanity is a divine person,
:an eternal, indestructible, imperishable spiritual body,
:not a machine made solid from matter,
:nor is it that matter first exists and a spirit dwells in it;
:all such dualism is mistaken.
:Rather, matter is the shadow of spirit, the product of mind —
:just as it is not the case that a cocoon first exists and a silkworm dwells within it,
:but rather the silkworm first spins thread and makes a cocoon,
:and the silkworm itself dwells within that cocoon.
:The true nature of humanity is first a life that is spirit,
:which weaves the threads of mind to make the cocoon of the body,
:and causes its own spirit to dwell within that cocoon —
:only then does spirit become the physical body.
:Know clearly: the cocoon is not the silkworm;
:therefore the physical body is not humanity
:but merely the cocoon of humanity.
:When the time comes, just as the silkworm breaks through the cocoon and undergoes metamorphosis to ascend,
:humanity too will break through the cocoon of the body and ascend to the spirit realm.
:Never regard the death and dissolution of the physical body as the death of humanity.
:Because humanity is life,
:it always knows no death.
:According to thought,
:according to time,
:according to need,
:various states may manifest in the body and circumstances,
:but life itself does not fall ill;
:life itself does not die.
:By changing one's thoughts,
:one can freely change one's health and circumstances.
:But you —
:eventually the time will come when life no longer needs the cocoon of the body.
:At such a time,
:life will break through the cocoon of the body
:and soar to a realm of even greater freedom.
:Do not call this the death of humanity.
:Because the fundamental nature of humanity is life,
:there is never any dying.
:— As the angel spoke thus,
:in the void were heard the subtle sounds of heavenly music,
:and petals rained down from somewhere unknown,
:as if praising the truth taught by the heavenly messenger.

:(End of Sacred Scripture)

:May the merit of this be extended universally to all;
:may we and all living beings together realize the true image.
